findings.description: OTP secret fallbacks are removed, production routes use configured application secrets, and certification security controls pass.
findings.title: Credential and security boundaries hardened

findings.description: The release manifest gate refuses to build from a dirty repository.
findings.remediation: Commit or isolate all intended changes and rerun release-manifest validation.
findings.title: Release manifest requires a clean worktree

findings.description: SQLite/synthetic validation does not prove PostgreSQL migration behavior.
findings.remediation: Run a controlled PostgreSQL migration and rollback rehearsal outside this evidence-only task.
findings.title: PostgreSQL migration rehearsal is not evidenced

findings.description: No production-like backup/restore rehearsal was executed.
findings.remediation: Complete and sign a backup/restore drill before deployment approval.
findings.title: Backup and restore evidence is missing

findings.description: The repository does not provide signed production monitoring and ownership acceptance evidence.
findings.remediation: Obtain operations sign-off, alert routing, on-call ownership, and runbook acceptance.
findings.title: Monitoring and operational ownership are not evidenced

findings.description: Local configuration references were reviewed without exposing values; secret-store/provider revocation evidence is external to this workspace.
findings.remediation: Attach secret-manager rotation and revocation attestation before production sign-off.
findings.title: Provider-side credential revocation is not locally attestable

recommended_release_gates: clean worktree and successful release-manifest verification
monitoring, alert routing, and operational ownership sign-off
remaining_risks: Release manifest requires a clean worktree
